      HOW WE SCORE

      Four parts, 100 points.

      The FI Score sums up our research on the maker and the product. It isn’t a certificate or a guarantee, so check the product suits your project.

      1. UP TO 40

        Maker check

        Company registration checked on the official register: 20 points (6 if it’s only claimed). An audit badge we checked: 10 (4 if it’s shown but not checked). Years in business: 10 for 10 or more, 7 for 5 or more, 4 for 2 or more.

      2. UP TO 30

        Product proof

        Each certificate or test we confirmed with the issuer: 12 points. Claimed but not yet checked: 3. Failed our check: minus 8. A certificate that doesn’t apply to the product’s category doesn’t count.

      3. UP TO 15

        Value

        How far the price is under a similar product sold in Australia. Full marks at 50% under. No points until we’ve compared it.

      4. UP TO 15

        Buyers

        From real buyer reviews only. Until a product has reviews, this part is 0, and the score is an early score, based on our research.

      What the labels mean

      • Verified: confirmed on the issuer’s own register or database
      • Claimed: the maker says so, and we haven’t checked it yet
      • Failed: we checked, and it didn’t match
      • Not stated: the maker’s page doesn’t say
